new='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

            for c in range(w):
                color = grid[r][c]
                nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
                if not (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and grid[nr][nc] == color):
                    continue
                # Boundary-touching pairs are part of the seed shape, not an extendable segment.
                if r in (0, h - 1) or c in (0, w - 1) or nr in (0, h - 1) or nc in (0, w - 1):

                for sr, sc in ((-dr, -dc), (dr, dc)):
                    rr, cc = (r, c) if (sr, sc) == (-dr, -dc) else (nr, nc)
                    rr += sr
                    cc += sc
                    while 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w and grid[rr][cc] == background:
                        out[rr][cc] = color
                        rr += sr
                        cc += sc
